fullText.simplified:
有危险

    一天，孙策工作完，想去山上走走，几个助手和他一起去。
    他们骑马站在山上。山下是河，河那边是荆州。天气很好，他们看得到荆州的山和房子。
    孙策看着河那边的荆州，说：“明年，我们就去打荆州！”
    助手们说：“好的，我们已经准备好了。”
    孙策很高兴，他骑着马在山上跑，越跑越快。助手们跑得慢，很快就看不到他了。他跑了一会儿，突然看到三个人。那三个人站在树下面，样子有些奇怪。他下了马，问：“你们是什么人？在这儿做什么？”
    有一个人说：“我们的主人死了，我们在这儿等人。”
    孙策问：“你们的主人是谁？你们在等谁？”
    那个人说：“有个叫孙策的人杀了我们的主人，我们在等孙策。”
    孙策没有说话，他打了这么多年仗，杀过的人太多了，他不知道他们说的主人是谁。那三个人一直看着他，样子很奇怪。
    有危险！孙策突然明白了！这三个人知道他就是孙策！
    孙策马上去拿刀，但是那三个人也马上拿出了刀。他们都比孙策快，孙策还没有准备好，他们的刀就过来了。
    孙策的脸和头都很疼！真的太疼了！孙策听不到自己的心跳，也看不清楚前面的路，他觉得自己要死了，但是他不能死啊！他努力往山下跑，那三个人拿着刀跟在后面。
就在这个时候，孙策听到几个人的声音，都在着急地问：“什么人？”
    这是他的助手们！助手们来了！孙策不害怕了，他想笑，但是脸太疼，他不能笑，也说不出话，眼前只有一个颜色——黑色。黑色越来越多，他什么都听不到了……他像睡着了一样，什么都不知道了。
fullText.traditional:
有危險

    一天，孫策工作完，想去山上走走，幾個助手和他一起去。
    他們騎馬站在山上。山下是河，河那邊是荊州。天氣很好，他們看得到荊州的山和房子。
    孫策看著河那邊的荊州，說：“明年，我們就去打荊州！”
    助手們說：“好的，我們已經準備好了。”
    孫策很高興，他騎著馬在山上跑，越跑越快。助手們跑得慢，很快就看不到他了。他跑了一會兒，突然看到三個人。那三個人站在樹下面，樣子有些奇怪。他下了馬，問：“你們是什麼人？在這兒做什麼？”
    有一個人說：“我們的主人死了，我們在這兒等人。”
    孫策問：“你們的主人是誰？你們在等誰？”
    那個人說：“有個叫孫策的人殺了我們的主人，我們在等孫策。”
    孫策沒有說話，他打了這麼多年仗，殺過的人太多了，他不知道他們說的主人是誰。那三個人一直看著他，樣子很奇怪。
    有危險！孫策突然明白了！這三個人知道他就是孫策！
    孫策馬上去拿刀，但是那三個人也馬上拿出了刀。他們都比孫策快，孫策還沒有準備好，他們的刀就過來了。
    孫策的臉和頭都很疼！真的太疼了！孫策聽不到自己的心跳，也看不清楚前面的路，他覺得自己要死了，但是他不能死啊！他努力往山下跑，那三個人拿著刀跟在後面。
就在這個時候，孫策聽到幾個人的聲音，都在著急地問：“什麼人？”
    這是他的助手們！助手們來了！孫策不害怕了，他想笑，但是臉太疼，他不能笑，也說不出話，眼前只有一個顏色——黑色。黑色越來越多，他什麼都聽不到了……他像睡著了一樣，什麼都不知道了。

sentences.simplified: 一天，孙策工作完，想去山上走走，几个助手和他一起去。
sentences.traditional: 一天，孫策工作完，想去山上走走，幾個助手和他一起去。
sentences.pinyin: yì tiān sūn cè gōng zuò wán xiǎng qù shān shang zǒu zǒu jǐ ge zhù shǒu hé tā yì qǐ qù
sentences.english: One day, Sun Ce finished work and wanted to take a stroll in the mountains. Several assistants went with him.

sentences.simplified: 他们骑马站在山上。
sentences.traditional: 他們騎馬站在山上。
sentences.pinyin: tā men qí mǎ zhàn zài shān shang
sentences.english: They stood on the mountain, on horseback.

sentences.simplified: 山下是河，河那边是荆州。
sentences.traditional: 山下是河，河那邊是荊州。
sentences.pinyin: shān xià shì hé hé nà bian shì jīng zhōu
sentences.english: At the bottom of the mountain was a river, and on the other side of the river was Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 天气很好，他们看得到荆州的山和房子。
sentences.traditional: 天氣很好，他們看得到荊州的山和房子。
sentences.pinyin: tiān qì hěn hǎo tā men kàn de dào jīng zhōu de shān hé fáng zi
sentences.english: The weather was very good, and they could see the mountains and houses in Jingzhou.

sentences.simplified: 孙策看着河那边的荆州，说：“明年，我们就去打荆州！”
sentences.traditional: 孫策看著河那邊的荊州，說：“明年，我們就去打荊州！”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè kàn zhe hé nà bian de jīng zhōu shuō míng nián wǒ men jiù qù dǎ jīng zhōu
sentences.english: Sun Ce looked at Jingzhou on the other side of the river and said, “Next year, we’ll go and fight Jingzhou!”

sentences.simplified: 助手们说：“好的，我们已经准备好了。”
sentences.traditional: 助手們說：“好的，我們已經準備好了。”
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu men shuō hǎo de wǒ men yǐ jīng zhǔn bèi hǎo le
sentences.english: His assistants said, “Okay, we’re ready.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策很高兴，他骑着马在山上跑，越跑越快。
sentences.traditional: 孫策很高興，他騎著馬在山上跑，越跑越快。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè hěn gāo xìng tā qí zhe mǎ zài shān shang pǎo yuè pǎo yuè kuài
sentences.english: Sun Ce was very happy. He rode his horse on the mountain, riding faster and faster.

sentences.simplified: 助手们跑得慢，很快就看不到他了。
sentences.traditional: 助手們跑得慢，很快就看不到他了。
sentences.pinyin: zhù shǒu men pǎo de màn hěn kuài jiù kàn bú dào tā le
sentences.english: His assistants were riding slowly, and soon Sun Ce was out of sight.

sentences.simplified: 他跑了一会儿，突然看到三个人。
sentences.traditional: 他跑了一會兒，突然看到三個人。
sentences.pinyin: tā pǎo le yí huì'r tū rán kàn dào sān ge rén
sentences.english: He rode for a while, and suddenly he saw three people.

sentences.simplified: 那三个人站在树下面，样子有些奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 那三個人站在樹下面，樣子有些奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: nà sān ge rén zhàn zài shù xià miàn yàng zi yǒu xiē qí guài
sentences.english: Those three people stood under a tree. They looked a little strange.

sentences.simplified: 他下了马，问：“你们是什么人？在这儿做什么？”
sentences.traditional: 他下了馬，問：“你們是什麼人？在這兒做什麼？”
sentences.pinyin: tā xià le mǎ wèn nǐ men shì shén me rén zài zhè‘r zuò shén me
sentences.english: He got off his horse and asked, “Who are you people? What are you doing here?”

sentences.simplified: 有一个人说：“我们的主人死了，我们在这儿等人。”
sentences.traditional: 有一個人說：“我們的主人死了，我們在這兒等人。”
sentences.pinyin: yǒu yí ge rén shuō wǒ men de zhǔ rén sǐ le wǒ men zài zhè‘r děng rén
sentences.english: One of them said, “Our master has died. We are here waiting for someone.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策问：“你们的主人是谁？你们在等谁？”
sentences.traditional: 孫策問：“你們的主人是誰？你們在等誰？”
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè wèn nǐ men de zhǔ rén shì shéi nǐ men zài děng shéi
sentences.english: Sun Ce asked, “Who is your master? Who are you waiting for?”

sentences.simplified: 那个人说：“有个叫孙策的人杀了我们的主人，我们在等孙策。”
sentences.traditional: 那個人說：“有個叫孫策的人殺了我們的主人，我們在等孫策。”
sentences.pinyin: nà ge rén shuō yǒu ge jiào sūn cè de rén shā le wǒ men de zhǔ rén wǒ men zài děng sūn cè
sentences.english: That person said, “A man named Sun Ce killed our master. We are waiting for Sun Ce.”

sentences.simplified: 孙策没有说话，他打了这么多年仗，杀过的人太多了，
sentences.traditional: 孫策沒有說話，他打了這麼多年仗，殺過的人太多了，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè méi yǒu shuō huà tā dǎ le zhè me duō nián zhàng shā guò de rén tài duō le
sentences.english: Sun Ce did not say anything. He had fought in wars for many years and had killed very many people.

sentences.simplified: 他不知道他们说的主人是谁。
sentences.traditional: 他不知道他們說的主人是誰。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù zhī dào tā men shuō de zhǔ rén shì shéi
sentences.english: He did not know the master they were talking about.

sentences.simplified: 那三个人一直看着他，样子很奇怪。
sentences.traditional: 那三個人一直看著他，樣子很奇怪。
sentences.pinyin: nà sān ge rén yì zhí kàn zhe tā yàng zi hěn qí guài
sentences.english: The three people kept staring at him. They looked very strange.

sentences.simplified: 有危险！孙策突然明白了！这三个人知道他就是孙策！
sentences.traditional: 有危險！孫策突然明白了！這三個人知道他就是孫策！
sentences.pinyin: yǒu wēi xiǎn sūn cè tū rán míng bai le zhè sān ge rén zhī dào tā jiù shì sūn cè
sentences.english: Danger! Sun Ce suddenly understood! These three people knew that he was Sun Ce!

sentences.simplified: 孙策马上去拿刀，但是那三个人也马上拿出了刀。
sentences.traditional: 孫策馬上去拿刀，但是那三個人也馬上拿出了刀。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè mǎ shàng qù ná dāo dàn shì nà sān ge rén yě mǎ shàng ná chū le dāo
sentences.english: Sun Ce immediately drew his sword, but the three people also drew their swords.

sentences.simplified: 他们都比孙策快，孙策还没有准备好，他们的刀就过来了。
sentences.traditional: 他們都比孫策快，孫策還沒有準備好，他們的刀就過來了。
sentences.pinyin: tā men dōu bǐ sūn cè kuài sūn cè hái méi yǒu zhǔn bèi hǎo tā men de dāo jiù guò lái le
sentences.english: They were all faster than Sun Ce. Sun Ce was not ready, and their swords came swinging over.

sentences.simplified: 孙策的脸和头都很疼！真的太疼了！
sentences.traditional: 孫策的臉和頭都很疼！真的太疼了！
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè de liǎn hé tóu dōu hěn téng zhēn de tài téng le
sentences.english: Sun Ce’s face and head hurt! They hurt really badly!

sentences.simplified: 孙策听不到自己的心跳，也看不清楚前面的路，
sentences.traditional: 孫策聽不到自己的心跳，也看不清楚前面的路，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè tīng bú dào zì jǐ de xīn tiào yě kàn bù qīng chu qián miàn de lù
sentences.english: Sun Ce couldn’t hear his own heartbeat, nor could he see the road ahead.

sentences.simplified: 他觉得自己要死了，但是他不能死啊！
sentences.traditional: 他覺得自己要死了，但是他不能死啊！
sentences.pinyin: tā jué de zì jǐ yào sǐ le dàn shì tā bù néng sǐ a
sentences.english: He felt like he was going to die, but he couldn’t die!

sentences.simplified: 他努力往山下跑，那三个人拿着刀跟在后面。
sentences.traditional: 他努力往山下跑，那三個人拿著刀跟在後面。
sentences.pinyin: tā nǔ lì wǎng shān xià pǎo nà sān ge rén ná zhe dāo gēn zài hòu miàn
sentences.english: He was trying very hard to run down the mountain. The three people followed, holding their swords.

sentences.simplified: 就在这个时候，孙策听到几个人的声音，都在着急地问：“什么人？”
sentences.traditional: 就在這個時候，孫策聽到幾個人的聲音，都在著急地問：“什麼人？”
sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè ge shí hou sūn cè tīng dào jǐ ge rén de shēng yīn dōu zài zháo jí de wèn shén me rén
sentences.english: Just then, Sun Ce heard some voices, all asking anxiously, “Who?”

sentences.simplified: 这是他的助手们！助手们来了！
sentences.traditional: 這是他的助手們！助手們來了！
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì tā de zhù shǒu men zhù shǒu men lái le
sentences.english: These were his assistants! His assistants came!

sentences.simplified: 孙策不害怕了，他想笑，但是脸太疼，
sentences.traditional: 孫策不害怕了，他想笑，但是臉太疼，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè bú hài pà le tā xiǎng xiào dàn shì liǎn tài téng
sentences.english: Sun Ce was not scared anymore. He wanted to smile, but his face hurt too much.

sentences.simplified: 他不能笑，也说不出话，眼前只有一个颜色——黑色。
sentences.traditional: 他不能笑，也說不出話，眼前只有一個顏色——黑色。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù néng xiào yě shuō bù chū huà yǎn qián zhǐ yǒu yí ge yán sè hēi sè
sentences.english: He was unable to smile and also unable to speak. He could only see one color—black.

sentences.simplified: 黑色越来越多，他什么都听不到了……
sentences.traditional: 黑色越來越多，他什麼都聽不到了……
sentences.pinyin: hēi sè yuè lái yuè duō tā shén me dōu tīng bú dào le
sentences.english: There was more and more black. He couldn’t hear anything anymore …

sentences.simplified: 他像睡着了一样，什么都不知道了。
sentences.traditional: 他像睡著了一樣，什麼都不知道了。
sentences.pinyin: tā xiàng shuì zháo le yí yàng shén me dōu bù zhī dào le
sentences.english: It was as if he had fallen asleep. He was no longer aware of anything.

sentence_translations: Danger
One day, Sun Ce finished work and wanted to take a stroll in the mountains. Several assistants went with him.
They stood on the mountain, on horseback.
At the bottom of the mountain was a river, and on the other side of the river was Jingzhou.
The weather was very good, and they could see the mountains and houses in Jingzhou.
Sun Ce looked at Jingzhou on the other side of the river and said, “Next year, we’ll go and fight Jingzhou!”
His assistants said, “Okay, we’re ready.”
Sun Ce was very happy. He rode his horse on the mountain, riding faster and faster.
His assistants were riding slowly, and soon Sun Ce was out of sight.
He rode for a while, and suddenly he saw three people.
Those three people stood under a tree. They looked a little strange.
He got off his horse and asked, “Who are you people? What are you doing here?”
One of them said, “Our master has died. We are here waiting for someone.”
Sun Ce asked, “Who is your master? Who are you waiting for?”
That person said, “A man named Sun Ce killed our master. We are waiting for Sun Ce.”
Sun Ce did not say anything. He had fought in wars for many years and had killed very many people.
He did not know the master they were talking about.
The three people kept staring at him. They looked very strange.
Danger! Sun Ce suddenly understood! These three people knew that he was Sun Ce!
Sun Ce immediately drew his sword, but the three people also drew their swords.
They were all faster than Sun Ce. Sun Ce was not ready, and their swords came swinging over.
Sun Ce’s face and head hurt! They hurt really badly!
Sun Ce couldn’t hear his own heartbeat, nor could he see the road ahead.
He felt like he was going to die, but he couldn’t die!
He was trying very hard to run down the mountain. The three people followed, holding their swords.
Just then, Sun Ce heard some voices, all asking anxiously, “Who?”
These were his assistants! His assistants came!
Sun Ce was not scared anymore. He wanted to smile, but his face hurt too much.
He was unable to smile and also unable to speak. He could only see one color—black.
There was more and more black. He couldn’t hear anything anymore …
It was as if he had fallen asleep. He was no longer aware of anything.
